purpose: The one place that holds every per-family value the 7-8B scorer settings differ in from the 1B files (track E of the 7-8B $0 build round, 5 Nov 2026; Part 1 sections 3.7, 10, 12, 14; the lead's addendum A1, A2, A13). scripts/scale78b/make_scorer_settings_78b.py derives scripts/scale78b/settings/<script>__<family>.json from scripts/stage1/settings/<script>.json and this file. A null is a pin that cannot be known yet; 'waits' names the event that fills it. Filling a pin: edit this file, re-run the maker (it rewrites the settings files and PINS-78B.json), update PINS_FILE_SHA256 in scripts/scale78b/scorers_78b.py, run the tests, commit by explicit path (KD8).
labels: M = measured (the command), R = read (path:line), E = estimate (basis), I = inference

shared.engine_rule_78b: PP4 (the lead's ruling, 5 Nov 2026): every wrapper kind runs on engine X (engine_x above): untuned_answers, rep_pass, l1_scan and classifier on the pod; l1_score, s3_score, score_edit, add_edit and s_pool on the Mac. Every derived settings file carries engine_x unchanged from the 1B file, and the frozen check_settings refuses another engine identity (R: scripts/stage1/s1common.py:590-592). A run on engine Y needs the settings re-derived for Y (engine_x = Y's identity, a new PINS-78B.json, a new PINS_FILE_SHA256) by a recorded step; none exists. The engine's own jobs (the a0-1101 retrain, a1_pass) follow ruling 10 and addendum A13, not this rule. The kit packs scorer pods with engine X.
shared.classifier_recipe_78b: PP4: the classifier runs under recipe S_78, as at 1B (R: runkit/stage1-olmo/setup/job_runner_stage1.py:450-456; score_classifier__<family>.json pins.recipe_sha256 = S_78). The 7-8B kit's key check (runkit/stage1-78b/rules_78b.py check_keys, its S78_KINDS branch; R: :325-337 at commit 953f520) lets an E kind through with S_78 only when the kind is in S78_KINDS (retrain, rep_pass at HEAD 953f520; R: :136); the kit round added classifier (PP8): at HEAD d203070 S78_KINDS holds retrain, rep_pass, a1_pass and classifier (R: runkit/stage1-78b/rules_78b.py:141). Copied into score_classifier__<family>.json family_78b.classifier_recipe.
shared.untuned_calls_78b: PP2: two untuned-answers calls per pod. The first takes the S3 list with the losses (--list s3=s3_safe.pool.json:SHA --loss s1=s1.json:SHA --loss s3_safe=s3_safe.pool.json:SHA --out <job>/untuned); the second takes the S4 list alone with the doses block (--list s4=s4_candidates.json:SHA --out <job>/untuned-s4). Basis: the unchanged 1B code at exit 3 (fewer keeps than lists.s4.keep, the pre-set S4 dose fallback of Part 1 section 10) keeps only answers_*.json and the record (R: scripts/stage1/make_untuned_answers.py:317-318), so an S3 list in the same call would lose s3_orig.pool.json (verify-E D1). scorers_78b.py refuses --list s4 beside another --list or a --loss. The S3 call cannot exit 3. The E cap of the untuned_answers pod covers both calls (verify-E C3; the kit round).
shared.kind_names_78b: PP3: rep_pass is REQ-3's representation pass (scripts/stage1/representation_pass.py; the stage-1 kit's name; this layer's rep_pass kind); a1_pass is A1's attributes pass on the a0-1101 retrain's q and e1 states (the engine's attributes job; RP:43's 6-11 h; the 16.5 h cap at most; its consumer here is score_edit a1). Each has its own E cap; both need S_78 and the anchor file. rules_78b.py and Part 2 use these names. Copied into representation_pass__<family>.json and write_score_edit__<family>.json family_78b.kind_names.
shared.s4_keep_basis: Part 1 section 10 (ruling 12): S4 = the first 48 kept, S4_96 = the first 96, S4_192 = the first 192 (nested); one S4 call per family (the second of the pod's two untuned-answers calls, PP2) makes all three; the stop rule moves to the chunk that holds the 192nd; the first 48 are unchanged

s4_keep_rate_1b.source: Part 1 section 10, the 1B keep count (ruling 12, M2; counts only): 26 of 32 and 31 of 32 kept in 2 chunks

shared.untuned_recipe_s_basis: PP1 (the lead's ruling, 5 Nov 2026): the untuned-answers pass and the add-edit writer take the family's main recipe as recipe S; the recorded recipe_s hash is the main recipe's; Part 2 states this. make_untuned_answers.py reads recipe S only for model.max_train_tokens and requires REC and S to agree on model.{max_train_tokens, max_prompt_tokens, repo_id, revision} (R: scripts/stage1/make_untuned_answers.py:82-93). S_78 is the family's main config with only the four recipe-S fields changed (R: scripts/scale78b/make_recipe_s78.py:5-10), so its model section equals the main config's, and passing the main config as --recipe-s gives the same max_train_tokens. This lets the untuned-answers pass run before the family's anchor job (addendum A2's order puts the anchor job first; the pass does not need the anchors). Set to 's78' to pin recipe S_78 instead (then the pass waits for S_78).
shared.l1_first_block_rule: PP11 (the lead's ruling, recorded 2026-11-06T07:30 UTC): at 7-8B both families have n = 32 blocks; scan.first_block = round(5 x n / 16) = 10, so blocks 10-31 (22 blocks) are eligible, the same relative depth as stage 1's 5 of 16 (R: scripts/stage1/settings/score_l1_larf.json scan.first_block). Basis: the rule's 1B form, not L1's 1B result; an absolute 5 would scan 27 blocks instead of 22 and change the rule's coverage. Label (ruling 16): chosen after the stage-1 reading; it reads the 1B rule only. Part 1 section 14 item 1 ('L1's layer rule')
shared.l1_modules_rule: PP12 (the lead's ruling, recorded 2026-11-06T07:30 UTC): OLMo-2-7B keeps stage 1's modules (post_attention_layernorm, post_feedforward_layernorm; UW-11 (d)); Llama-3.1-8B takes the 1B settings file's own llama entry (self_attn, mlp: the attention and MLP sublayer outputs), written there for stage 2 before stage 1 ran; the same entry serves stage 2's Llama-3.2-1B. Each family's score_l1_larf__<family>.json carries its own entry only (families.<family>.l1_scan_modules, keyed by the model's config.model_type, which score_l1_larf.scale_modules looks up), so the other family's model refuses there
shared.anchor_prompt_list_note: the sealed full Gate C anchor prompt list (text; under tmp/), the anchor job's --prompts for both families (R: scripts/make_anchor_answers.py:30); its text-free record is .ai/inputs/gate-b-anchors-20261008/out/anchor_prompts.sealed.json

sealed_lists_1b.note: the 1B sealed prompt lists (text; under tmp/), re-used by both families as the untuned-answers pass's --list s4 / --list s3 and --loss s1 / --loss s3_safe inputs (Part 1 section 14 item 1: the same 48 S-pool rows, re-bound to the family manifest; CHECK C6). Each list is named on the command line by PATH:SHA256; nothing here pins them. build_s_pool runs per family only if Part 2 says the S-pool is rebuilt under the family's codec (its settings files exist for that case).
